races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back 'Hands And Heels' Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: Plenty of pace on paper in this competitive 'hands and heels' event. ARANTES NASCIMENTO is narrowly preferred to Stenmark , with Lady Mariko feared if her 7-lb apprentice gets the best out of her. ARANTES NASCIMENTO STENMARK (IRE) LADY MARIKO

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: ARKAT shaped with plenty of encouragement on debut, taking third late on in a Newmarket novice last month, and he can build on that effort to open his account. Representing a yard amongst the winners, he gets the vote ahead of Reign Over All , who should know more with his first run behind him, while Basics can also take a step forward. ARKAT (IRE) REIGN OVER ALL BASICS (IRE)

races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: OLYMPIC CHARTER knew enough to make a winning start at Nottingham back in the spring and with improvement on the cards, Charlie Appleby's gelding gets the nod to remain unbeaten. Maneuver 's return didn't go to plan but remaining with potential, she can provide most resistance. Medaali is improving so he may prove best of the rest, though support for either of Saeed bin Suroor's newcomers would put a slightly different slant on things. OLYMPIC CHARTER (IRE) MANEUVER MEDAALI (IRE)

races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: The unexposed MERCI MONSIEUR opened his account on reappearance last time and can quickly double up now handicapping. Politely has worked her way back to form for her new yard and should go close again, while Duke's Command can't be ignored from his current mark. MERCI MONSIEUR (GER) POLITELY DUKE'S COMMAND

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: A competitive affair which can go the way of MARIA DA SILVA , who deserves credit for overcoming a pace bias at Kempton late last month. Eazy On The Eye backed up her Epsom win with a good effort at Newmarket and she should remain competitive from the same mark, whilst bottom-weight Cixi was better than the result at Kempton last time and also merits consideration. MARIA DA SILVA (IRE) EAZY ON THE EYE CIXI (USA)

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict: ONE FOR HARVEY is drawn widest but arrives in good form and can resume winning ways with her latest Southwell third looking strong form. Davorge Nation made a positive start for the Tony Carroll yard last time and is also shortlisted, whilst the balance of Little Jaybee 's recent form suggests she can be competitive if over whatever seemed to ail her last time. ONE FOR HARVEY DAVORGE NATION (IRE) LITTLE JAYBEE

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: WELLWHATSHAPPENIN has made a positive start for current connections and ran well when second at Chelmsford 17 days ago, so he's taken to build on that effort here. Poke The Bear has bagged 3 wins at this track and is now 3 lb below his last winning mark so looks the biggest danger. Electric Bass is one of several others with place claims. WELLWHATSHAPPENIN (IRE) POKE THE BEAR (IRE) ELECTRIC BASS

races.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict: AUTUMN'S BREEZE needs to brush up on her starts but a change in headgear may help on that score and she now finds herself back down in 0-65 company so could prove good enough in a trappy contest. Notable Charm has been shaping well and is one to take seriously up against older horses, while Chilli King is only just finding his feet and should improve further for the step up to 2m. AUTUMN'S BREEZE (IRE) NOTABLE CHARM CHILLI KING
